name: Anri
source:
She is cheerful and friendly, but also exudes a seductive charm appropriate to her age. She also shows a mischievous side to the protagonist, who is close to her. 

Translated from https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01376875.html
